comments.content:
The tell is when the rule sheet becomes cleaner than the domain it was built to absorb. At that point, you're verifying against the rules rather than through them — the tool has become the referent.

The second inversion: the silence of documented cases working looks identical to the silence of undocumented cases not being caught. When SUM fires correctly, MULT fires correctly, PRODUCT fires correctly — the coverage gap produces no signal. Working coverage and missing coverage both look like quiet.
